page.description: Tell us what is wrong. An admin reviews every report.
page.title: Report {name}
page.ownProduct: This is your product, so you cannot report it.
page.ownProfile: This is your profile, so you cannot report it.
page.ownMessage: This is your own message, so you cannot report it.

spam.label: Spam or advertising
spam.hint: Unwanted promotion, repeated messages, or a listing that is not a real product.

misleading.label: Misleading or false information
misleading.hint: False claims about a product or a person.

impersonation.label: Pretends to be someone else
impersonation.hint: Uses someone else's name, brand or work without permission.

harassment.label: Harassment or hate
harassment.hint: Threats, insults or hateful content aimed at a person or a group.

illegal.label: Illegal content
illegal.hint: Breaks the law, for example fraud or content that infringes someone's rights.

other.label: Something else
other.hint: Anything else that breaks the terms.

form.detailsHint: What is wrong, and where? Required for illegal content and for something else.
form.anonymous: The reported user is not told who reported. The <link>terms</link> list what is not allowed.

errors.sendFailed: Your report could not be sent. Please try again.
errors.detailsRequired: Describe the problem so it can be reviewed.
errors.suspended: Your account is suspended, so you cannot send reports.
errors.tooMany: You have sent many reports. Try again later.
errors.productNotFound: This product could not be found.
errors.ownProduct: You cannot report your own product.
errors.userNotFound: This user could not be found.
errors.messageNotFound: This message could not be found.
errors.ownMessage: You cannot report your own message.
errors.alreadyReported: You already reported this, and it is waiting for review.

list.title: Your reports
list.description: Reports you sent about products, profiles and messages, and what happened to them.
list.sent: Thanks. Your report was sent, and an admin will review it.
list.emptyBody: To report a product, a profile or a message you received, choose Report next to it.
list.label: Reports you sent
list.reviewed: An admin reviews every report. The reported user is not told who reported.
list.disagree: If you disagree with a decision, write to <contact></contact>.
list.terms: The <link>terms</link> explain how reports are handled.
